items.title: CFTC roundup notes former senator Blanche Lincoln now lobbying for Kalshi
items.content_text: - **CFTC roundup notes former senator Blanche Lincoln now lobbying for Kalshi** — A Next Event Horizon roundup on the CFTC cited reporting that former Democratic senator Blanche Lincoln, who once backed federal crackdowns on gambling through financial markets, is now lobbying for Kalshi, with her firm paid 480,000 dollars since 2024. The roundup also pointed to Supreme Court discussion of prediction markets by Vanderbilt law professor Yesha Yadav. ([Next Event Horizon](https://nexteventhorizon.substack.com/p/what-the-heck-is-going-on-at-cftc))

items.title: Investopedia explainer sets out the federal and state split over prediction market regulation
items.content_text: - **Investopedia explainer sets out the federal and state split over prediction market regulation** — Investopedia explains that the CFTC regulates prediction markets at the federal level and treats event contracts as derivatives, while many states view the contracts, especially sports contracts, as gambling. It says that tension is why access and rules vary by state. ([Investopedia](https://www.investopedia.com/how-are-prediction-markets-regulated-12142137))

items.title: Thirty days of esports data finds Polymarket in 13.2 percent of arbitrage cases and Kalshi in 2.8 percent
items.content_text: - **Thirty days of esports data finds Polymarket in 13.2 percent of arbitrage cases and Kalshi in 2.8 percent** — A dev.to analysis of esports prices from September 6 to October 6 across 25 sportsbooks plus Polymarket and Kalshi found about 4.87 million arbitrage cases in total. Polymarket appeared in 642,253 of them and Kalshi in 138,017, while the two prediction markets were mispriced against sportsbooks far more often than against each other. ([dev.to](https://dev.to/dozor/polymarket-kalshi-arbitrage-vs-sportsbooks-30-days-of-esports-data-1dc2))

items.title: Kalshi chief executive defends prediction market integrity on insider trading at DC Fintech Week

items.title: Kalshi faces conflicting claims over Oklahoma tribal partnership
items.content_text: - **Kalshi faces conflicting claims over Oklahoma tribal partnership** — Competing factions within the Alabama-Quassarte Tribal Town have taken opposing positions on the announced PokkeTrades partnership with Kalshi, according to reporting on the dispute. The Oklahoma Indian Gaming Association welcomed the pushback and said prediction markets are illegal Class III gaming under federal law, while Oklahoma tribal gaming compacts generated more than 221 million dollars in exclusivity fees in 2025. items.title: Torres insider trading bill draws more than 30 House backers
items.content_text: - **Torres insider trading bill draws more than 30 House backers** — Representative Ritchie Torres has formally introduced the Public Integrity in Financial Prediction Markets Act of 2026, backed by more than 30 Democratic lawmakers including former Speaker Nancy Pelosi. items.title: Kalshi launches gold and silver perpetual futures after CFTC approval
items.content_text: - **Kalshi launches gold and silver perpetual futures after CFTC approval** — Kalshi has launched perpetual futures tied to gold and silver in the United States after the CFTC approved the listing, the first non-crypto perpetual contracts cleared by the regulator. items.content_text: - **Single Polymarket whale holds 1.03 million dollar Republican position in Senate markets** — An on-chain analysis of Polymarket Senate trading from September 1 to October 7 found one account, lomneivan, holding a net 1.03 million dollars on Republicans across Senate control and six state races, with two thirds in South Carolina, Kansas and Ohio. The wider crowd went the other way, ending net long Democratic shares by about 210,000, and the whale would collect about 1.78 million dollars if every backed race wins. items.title: SEC extends review of MEMX securities event contracts proposal to November 25
items.content_text: - **SEC extends review of MEMX securities event contracts proposal to November 25** — The SEC has given itself until November 25, 2026 to decide on MEMX's proposal to list securities event contracts on its options platform. items.content_text: - **Kalshi has suspended candidates who bet on their own midterm races, Reuters reports** — Reuters reports Kalshi has suspended a handful of candidates for betting on their own races, and that campaign staffers have also wagered on races they worked on. items.title: Prediction markets give Bitcoin a 2 percent chance of 200,000 dollars in 2026, a record low

items.title: Senators back Prediction Markets Security and Integrity Act in new federal safety push
items.content_text: - **Senators back Prediction Markets Security and Integrity Act in new federal safety push** — The bill tracked as S.4060 would bar prediction-market contracts tied to war, death or military conflict, require insider-trading and manipulation safeguards, and shift day-to-day oversight of platforms away from the CFTC toward individual states. Lawmakers paired the push with the SAFE Bet Act on sportsbook deposit limits and affordability checks. ([ReadWrite](https://readwrite.com/prediction-markets-safety-push/))

items.title: Sixth Circuit ruling lets Tennessee and Ohio apply gambling laws to Kalshi sports contracts
items.content_text: - **Sixth Circuit ruling lets Tennessee and Ohio apply gambling laws to Kalshi sports contracts** — ReadWrite reports the Sixth Circuit ruled on September 25 that Tennessee and Ohio can regulate Kalshi sports-event contracts under state gambling laws, finding Kalshi had not shown the contracts qualify as swaps under exclusive CFTC jurisdiction. The decision vacated a Tennessee injunction and adds to the split among federal appeals courts. ([ReadWrite](https://readwrite.com/kalshi-prediction-markets-gambling-laws/))

items.title: Polymarket trader loses about 147,000 dollars on Eagles after late Jaguars field goal
items.content_text: - **Polymarket trader loses about 147,000 dollars on Eagles after late Jaguars field goal** — A Polymarket trader put about 146,700 dollars on the Philadelphia Eagles and was close to a 623,449 dollar payout before Jacksonville won 19-17 in London on a 57-yard field goal as time expired. items.title: Backtest of a forecast-based model against Kalshi temperature markets finds the market won
items.content_text: - **Backtest of a forecast-based model against Kalshi temperature markets finds the market won** — A backtest over 60 summer days found a public forecast model using a normal error distribution did not beat the day-before Kalshi temperature market price, with the tested strategies losing across price bands. The author notes the fattest pricing gaps sat in sub-10-cent tail brackets, where the normal assumption under-priced outcomes most. items.content_text: - **Researchers question parts of Kalshi and Polymarket perpetual futures volume as platforms deny wash trading** — A working paper by Ulm University finance professor Andre Guettler argues a material share of reported perpetual futures volume on the platforms may be manufactured, which would overstate the demand behind their valuations. Polymarket revenue and analytics head Kyle Gesuelli told CNBC the activity in its low-odds contracts comes from highly active sharp traders correcting mispricing, not wash trading. items.title: Appeals court sides with Nevada in Kalshi prediction market row
items.content_text: - **Appeals court sides with Nevada in Kalshi prediction market row** — A federal appeals court rejected Kalshi's bid to block Nevada gaming regulators from applying state gambling laws to its sports contracts. The panel said the contracts have the essential characteristics of sports betting and do not gain federal protection as swaps. ([GambleRSS](https://gamblerss.com/appeals-court-sides-with-nevada-in-kalshi-prediction-market-row-68503))

items.title: Sixth Circuit rules Kalshi sports contracts are not swaps
items.content_text: - **Sixth Circuit rules Kalshi sports contracts are not swaps** — A Sixth Circuit panel ruled that Kalshi's sports-event contracts are not swaps under federal law, removing CFTC preemption and leaving the products to state regulation. It is the second appeals court to rule against Kalshi on the question. ([WeeBet](https://weebet.com/news/kalshi-sixth-circuit-sports-contracts-state-regulation))

items.title: CFTC moves to rewrite swap rules to cover prediction market event contracts
items.content_text: - **CFTC moves to rewrite swap rules to cover prediction market event contracts** — The CFTC has proposed rules that would codify sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts as federally regulated swaps, while carving conventional casino-style gambling products out of that definition. The agency says the change would clarify that event contracts fall within its exclusive jurisdiction under the Commodity Exchange Act. ([CoinSpectator](https://coinspectator.com/mainstream/2026/10/10/why-the-cftc-is-rewriting-swap-rules-for-prediction-markets-and-how-it-shifts-the-balance-of-power/))

items.content_text: - **Kairos raises 2.5 million dollars in seed funding led by a16z Crypto** — Chicago-based startup Kairos has raised 2.5 million dollars in seed funding led by a16z Crypto as it launches a trading platform aimed at professional prediction market participants.
